test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing ‘1’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f2c8afc7974a8a64936cee2cd192ee7a8ea7685128125aca2fdc77f5a4e4a2.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53149521325addca21e6fddbbb91c383703dd712a7063a6ba2e3f1b826efa90b.png] 

As 1 and 6 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 2 and 5 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7be52e549a978da1162d803a5ac8c54ed34098bb92935d5774837997824a792.png] 

As 1 and 5 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 6 and 4 are opposite to each other.

Clearly, the remaining number 3 will be opposite to 1.

Hence, the correct answer is **"3"**.
